title: Selection-Aware Certification of Client-Constrained Fraud Rule Portfolios Under Synthetic Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2611.18687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Selecting fraud-rule portfolios to satisfy a precision or recall floor can overfit the data used for selection. We study finite-family certification for bounded OR portfolios, comparing point-estimate selection, a fixed safety margin, and one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bounds with Bonferroni adjustment. In a factorial follow-up with 6,400 datasets from two author-designed synthetic generators, full-validation certification reduced the held-out floor-violation rate by 29.1 percentage points on average versus full-validation point selection, while reducing deployment by 31.7 points. Compared with a fixed 0.05 margin, certification reduced violations by 22.2 points and deployment by 29.4 points; results varied across conditions. Using the full rather than half validation sample increased deployment by 17.1 points on average, without a uniform reduction in shifted-test violations. translated_title: 面向客户约束的欺诈规则组合在合成分布偏移下的选择感知认证
translated_abstract: 选择能够满足精确率或召回率下限要求的欺诈规则组合，可能会过拟合用于选择的数据。我们针对有界OR组合研究有限族认证方法，比较了点估计选择、固定安全裕度以及经Bonferroni调整的单侧Clopper-Pearson下界三种方法。在一项使用来自两个作者设计的合成生成器产生的6,400个数据集的因子追踪实验中，与全验证点估计选择相比，全验证认证平均将保留集的下限违反率降低了29.1个百分点，同时使部署率降低了31.7个百分点。与固定0.05的安全裕度相比，认证将违反率降低了22.2个百分点，部署率降低了29.4个百分点；结果因实验条件而异。使用完整而非一半的验证样本平均使部署率提高了17.1个百分点，但在偏移测试中的违反率并未出现一致的降低。在另一项单独的400个数据集无偏移扫描实验中，认证……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于单侧Clopper-Pearson下界结合Bonferroni调整的有限族统计认证方法，用于在合成分布偏移下部署欺诈规则组合，相比点估计选择和固定安全裕度，平均可降低约29个百分点的保留集下限违反率，但代价是部署率相应下降。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes finite-family statistical certification using one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bounds with Bonferroni adjustment for deploying fraud-rule portfolios under synthetic distribution shift, which reduces held-out floor-violation rates by about 29 percentage points compared to point-estimate selection and fixed safety margins, at the cost of lower deployment rates.
